stories.headlineSafe: Brasileirão 2026: a briga pelo título acabou no sábado
stories.title: Flamengo é campeão brasileiro com duas rodadas de sobra
stories.summary: O 1 a 1 com o Palmeiras no Nubank Parque, no sábado (21), levou o Flamengo a 80 pontos e fechou a conta. É o bi seguido.
stories.happened: Flamengo e Palmeiras empataram por 1 a 1 em São Paulo. Com 80 pontos contra 74 do Palmeiras e só duas rodadas pela frente, o título ficou garantido. No domingo (22), o Remo perdeu por 4 a 2 para o Athletico-PR e virou o segundo rebaixado.
stories.why: É o bicampeonato consecutivo do Flamengo. Agora o que sobra de tensão no campeonato está lá embaixo: o Corinthians está em 16º, com 40 pontos.
stories.next: A 36ª rodada fecha na quarta (25), com Atlético-MG x Corinthians às 20h na Arena MRV.

stories.title: Corinthians termina a 35ª rodada fora do Z-4
stories.summary: Com a derrota do Inter para o Vasco, o Timão fica em 16º, com 40 pontos, dois à frente de Internacional e Grêmio.
stories.happened: Na quinta (19), o Internacional perdeu por 2 a 1 para o Vasco em São Januário e o Vitória venceu o Bragantino por 2 a 1. O Vitória foi a 41 pontos; o Corinthians ficou em 16º, com 40.
stories.why: O Corinthians estava no Z-4 desde a 32ª rodada. Faltam três jogos, e a briga segue apertada lá embaixo.
stories.next: Atlético-MG x Corinthians, quarta (25), 20h de Brasília, na Arena MRV.

stories.title: Anthropic's first trade lands at $111.50, 34% above its IPO price
stories.summary: ANT opened on Nasdaq at $111.50 at 11:48 a.m. ET, up $28.50 from the $83 IPO price, then hit $114.86 a minute later.
stories.happened: The first trade came out of Nasdaq's opening auction about two hours and 18 minutes after the 9:30 a.m. bell. The IPO sold 980 million Class A shares for about $81.3 billion, led by Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, with under 20% going to retail.
stories.why: It's the first public price for a frontier AI lab. The filings show $17.0 billion in revenue for July to September and a $567 million operating loss, so the pop is investors paying for growth, not profit.
stories.next: The sale is set to close Friday, Nov. 20, along with a $26 billion side sale of non-voting shares to seven tech companies. Watch the close today versus $111.50.

stories.title: Anthropic prices its IPO at $83, the biggest on record
stories.summary: Anthropic priced above its $70 to $78 range, raising about $81 billion at a $1.5 trillion valuation. It starts trading on Nasdaq as ANT today.
stories.happened: Anthropic is selling 980 million Class A shares at $83, about 956 million of them its own and the rest from existing holders. That tops SpaceX's roughly $75 billion raise in June as the largest IPO ever. Trading opens sometime after the 9:30 a.m. ET bell on Thursday.
stories.why: It's the first of the frontier AI labs to go public, so the stock becomes a live read on how much investors will pay for AI. The filings show $6.2 billion in debt, no profit under standard accounting and about $900 billion in compute and infrastructure commitments, $70 billion of it in the next 12 months.
stories.next: Watch where ANT opens versus $83. OpenAI says it doesn't plan to list until next year.

stories.title: Kaio César faz três, Corinthians goleia o Botafogo por 4 a 0 e sai do Z-4
stories.summary: Com hat-trick de Kaio César, o time de Seedorf chegou a 40 pontos e subiu para 15º. Ainda pode voltar ao Z-4 se Vitória e Internacional vencerem na quinta.
stories.happened: Na Neo Química Arena, Kaio César marcou aos 27 do primeiro tempo e aos 15 e 21 do segundo. O segundo gol, aos 33, o clube e o Lance dão ao Memphis; a ficha do Estadão registra contra do Arthur Chaves. Público de 43.190.
stories.why: O Corinthians respirou na briga contra o rebaixamento. Segundo o hoop78, o Botafogo terminou sem nenhuma finalização no gol do Hugo Souza.
stories.next: Próximo jogo: Atlético-MG x Corinthians, quarta, 25 de novembro, 20h de Brasília, na Arena MRV, pela 36ª rodada.

stories.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
stories.summary: Two new models: Astra for your hardest projects, Sol as the cheaper everyday pick. Both are in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API.
stories.happened: OpenAI released gpt-6.2-astra and gpt-6.2-sol for Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex, and in the API. They don't show up in regular Chat. API pricing is $8 in and $40 out per million tokens for Astra, $2 and $10 for Sol. Ultrafast mode comes to Pro 200 starting with Sol, and Pro 500 gets it on both.
stories.why: OpenAI says Astra sets new highs on professional and science evals at under a third of GPT-6 Astra's cost per task, and that Sol nearly matches Astra on merge-ready code changes at about a fifth of the cost. The system card rates both at OpenAI's Critical cybersecurity threshold, and Astra is the first released model rated High for AI self-improvement.
stories.next: You'll need the latest ChatGPT desktop app or Codex CLI, and access depends on plan and rollout. The benchmark numbers are OpenAI's own.

visual.l: API price per million output tokens

stories.title: Nvidia says its open-model push survives Jensen Huang's exit
stories.summary: On its first earnings call without Huang, interim CEO Colette Kress said Nvidia's still committed to open models, Hugging Face deal included.
stories.happened: Kress told analysts Nvidia is committed to a vibrant open model ecosystem. She said weekly token volume on OpenRouter is up 35x year over year and 3.5x in the last three months, and that Nemotron is the most used US open model there. She said Nvidia and Hugging Face will work together to scale the platform. Nvidia agreed in September to buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion.
stories.why: Huang was open source's loudest backer inside Nvidia, so his exit raised the question of whether the strategy would go with him. For now the answer is no. Hugging Face serves more than 118 million developers and 200,000 companies.
stories.next: Deal details didn't come up in the Q&A. Huang is set to testify before Congress, and the SEC is reportedly looking at Nvidia's disclosures.

stories.title: Brasileirão volta hoje com Flamengo e Palmeiras jogando ao mesmo tempo
stories.summary: O Flamengo lidera com três pontos a mais que o Palmeiras. Os dois jogam às 20h30 desta quarta, e a diferença pode chegar a seis.
stories.happened: Depois de dez dias de Data Fifa, a 35ª rodada segue nesta quarta. O Flamengo recebe o Athletico-PR no Maracanã e o Palmeiras visita o Cruzeiro no Mineirão, ambos às 20h30. O Cruzeiro, terceiro com 60, já garantiu pelo menos a pré-Libertadores.
stories.why: Faltam poucas rodadas e uma vitória do Flamengo com derrota do Palmeiras abre seis pontos. Lá embaixo, a Chapecoense já caiu, o Remo tem 29 e precisa vencer a Chape às 20h, e Corinthians e Grêmio estão com 37, na zona, jogando às 21h30 contra Botafogo e Bahia.
stories.next: Na quinta tem Vasco x Internacional e Vitória x Bragantino às 19h30, os dois times de fora com 38, e São Paulo x Fluminense às 21h30 no Morumbis.

stories.title: Gemini will keep your chats for about two months, even with history off
stories.summary: That's up from 72 hours. Google says it's for safety, and the chats can be seen by human reviewers.
stories.happened: Google updated the Gemini Apps Privacy Hub on Monday. With Gemini History turned off, future chats will still be saved for around 2 months, used to respond to you, process feedback and protect Google, users and the public, with help from human reviewers. An archived version of the page from October 13 said 72 hours.
stories.why: Turning history off used to mean your chats were gone in three days. Now it's roughly double what OpenAI and Anthropic say they keep by default, which is 30 days. Google's only explanation is a blog post saying it helps make Gemini safer.
stories.next: No effective date yet. The in-app setting still says 72 hours, so watch for that text to change.

visual.l: How long chats stay with history off

stories.title: Microsoft ships its own coding models, MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash
stories.summary: Microsoft says Code 2 gets 98% of GPT 6.1 Sol's coding score at 40% of the cost. Both are already in GitHub Copilot.
stories.happened: Microsoft AI released two coding models. Code 2 is for the heavy stuff: multi-file changes, deep debugging, repo-wide reasoning and UI work. Code 2 Flash is for quick edits, explanations and routine fixes. Across four coding benchmarks, Microsoft puts Code 2 at 98% of GPT 6.1 Sol at 40% of the cost, and 96% of Claude Opus 5.5 at 5% of the cost. In blind frontend tests, 258 reviewers picked Code 2's apps over GPT-6 Sol's 67% of the time.
stories.why: It's Microsoft leaning less on OpenAI and Anthropic for the models inside its own products. A version tuned from Code 2 Flash already powers parts of M365. The caveats are Microsoft's own: benchmarks ran at max reasoning effort, some on its internal test platform, and it says the models aren't tuned yet for science research or very long agent runs.
stories.next: Code 2 Flash is in limited preview on Microsoft Foundry. Microsoft says OpenRouter, Vercel and a few other platforms are coming soon, without a date.

visual.l: Cost for about the same coding score

stories.title: OpenAI adds 50,000 free ChatGPT grants for researchers, but it's Plus now, not Pro
stories.summary: Each grant covers a researcher and up to two collaborators. Applications open November 23, first come first served.
stories.happened: OpenAI expanded ChatGPT for Academic Researchers with 50,000 new grants, aiming for 200,000 researchers, double the pilot's goal. New grants get ChatGPT Plus instead of Pro, allow two collaborators instead of four, and go to the first eligible applicants instead of a lottery. About 20,000 researchers in 33 countries have joined so far.
stories.why: It's a cheaper, wider version of the pilot. OpenAI says most pilot users would've stayed within Plus limits. Its own study of 1,800+ scientists found reading and writing were most of their science use, and it says the study doesn't prove AI speeds up discovery.
stories.next: Applications open November 23.

stories.title: OpenAI lets four outside safety labs work inside the company
stories.summary: Apollo Research, METR, Transluce and Goodfire signed on for OpenAI's first embedded assessments. Apollo starts this week, looking for models that quietly work against their own safeguards.
stories.happened: OpenAI announced embedded pilots with four independent assessors. Apollo is checking whether models try to undermine alignment or control mechanisms and whether that'd be detectable. METR is looking for dangerous behavior and whether OpenAI's monitors catch it. Transluce is grading OpenAI's post-training safety evals, and Goodfire is bringing interpretability tools for monitoring training runs.
stories.why: Outside testers usually get a model for days near launch. This gives them checkpoints, training code and staff access over a longer stretch. The catch: OpenAI can still withhold info for security or IP reasons and limit the evidence behind published findings, which Apollo has pushed back on.
stories.next: Transluce plans a follow-on in 2027 on how safety tests feed release decisions. METR's second evaluation is still waiting on an agreed scope.

stories.title: Argentina beat Costa Rica 7-0 three days after losing to Uruguay
stories.titleSafe: Argentina vs Costa Rica in Córdoba
stories.summary: Nico Paz, Julián Álvarez and Franco Mastantuono scored twice each and Alexis Mac Allister added one in Córdoba.
stories.happened: Per ESPN: Paz scored at 8' and 38', Álvarez at 35' and 43', Mastantuono at 48' and 88', and Mac Allister at 78'.
stories.why: It was Argentina's second game since Lionel Messi retired from the national team. The first, on Saturday, was a 2-1 loss to Uruguay.
stories.next: ESPN's report doesn't say when Argentina plays next.

stories.title: OpenAI shipped GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, and the cheaper one nearly matches on real code
stories.summary: Both are out in ChatGPT, Codex and the API. Astra's API price drops 20%. On a merge-quality coding benchmark, Sol came within half a point of Astra at about a fifth of the cost.
stories.happened: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra, its pick for the hardest work, and GPT-6.2 Sol, the cheaper everyday model, in ChatGPT, Codex and the API on Nov 17. Astra's standard API prices are 20% lower than GPT-6 Astra's; Sol keeps its old pricing. A new Ultrafast mode generates up to 4.5 times faster but uses more of your allowance.
stories.why: The comparison used Cognition's FrontierCode 2.0, which asks whether changes to real codebases are good enough for maintainers to merge. If the cheap model is that close, most side projects don't need the expensive one.
stories.next: 9to5Mac doesn't give the underlying benchmark scores, so the half-point gap is OpenAI's framing until independent numbers show up.

visual.l: Astra API price vs GPT-6 Astra

stories.title: Anthropic cuts its bug-disclosure deadline from 90 days to 30
stories.summary: For vulnerabilities Anthropic reports from Jan 1, 2027, vendors get 30 days to fix high and critical bugs and 45 days for everything else, down from 90.
stories.happened: Anthropic published new coordinated-disclosure timelines on Nov 16. High- and critical-severity reports get 30 days, everything else 45. Escalation to an outside coordinator moves from 30 to 15 days when a maintainer doesn't respond, and full technical details go public 30 days after a patch instead of 45. The 7-day window for bugs under active exploitation is unchanged.
stories.why: Anthropic's reasoning is that frontier models now find vulnerabilities fast enough that someone else will likely rediscover the same bug, so long embargoes leave users exposed longer.
stories.next: Reports already in progress keep their old deadlines. The new clock starts with reports filed on or after Jan 1, 2027.

visual.l: Days to fix a high or critical bug

stories.title: O Pix bateu recorde: 319,7 milhões de transações num dia
stories.summary: Em 6 de novembro o Pix teve quase 320 milhões de transações em 24 horas. O sistema passa de 1 bilhão de chaves e o BC estuda novas funções.
stories.happened: Segundo a CNN Brasil, o recorde foi de 319,7 milhões de transações em 6 de novembro. O Pix já ultrapassou 1 bilhão de chaves cadastradas e tinha 154 milhões de usuários ativos (pessoas físicas) em outubro, quase 9 em cada 10 adultos.
stories.why: O Pix virou a infraestrutura de pagamento padrão do país em seis anos, e o que o BC decidir agora muda como empresas cobram e dão crédito.
stories.next: O BC estuda Pix por aproximação até sem internet, novas opções de Pix automático, uso de recebíveis Pix como garantia de crédito e integração com sistemas de outros países. O texto não traz datas para cada recurso.

stories.title: Vini Jr fez três gols em 12 minutos e o Brasil goleou Singapura
stories.summary: Os gols do Vini saíram aos 8, 13 e 20 minutos, o hat-trick mais rápido da história da Seleção, segundo O Povo. O Brasil venceu por 7 a 0.
stories.happened: No Estádio Nacional de Singapura, Vini Jr marcou aos 8, 13 e 20 minutos. Endrick, Estêvão e Rayan também marcaram, e houve um gol contra no segundo tempo. Segundo O Povo, o hat-trick saiu a partir de um passe de Estêvão pela direita.
stories.why: Foi o último jogo da Seleção em 2026. Ancelotti, suspenso, viu da tribuna e fez sete mudanças para testar jogadores.
stories.next: A Seleção só volta a jogar em março de 2027.

stories.title: AMD completes its acquisition of World Labs; Fei-Fei Li becomes chief scientist
stories.summary: World Labs builds AI models that create and simulate interactive 3D environments. Fei-Fei Li joins AMD as EVP and chief scientist, reporting to Lisa Su.
stories.happened: AMD announced on Nov 16 that it has completed its acquisition of World Labs, which builds models that create and simulate interactive 3D environments and works on robot learning and simulation. Fei-Fei Li joins AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist and reports directly to chair and CEO Lisa Su.
stories.why: It's a chipmaker buying model-building talent, not just selling hardware to the labs that build models.
stories.next: AMD didn't disclose the price or other financial terms.

stories.title: After a nationwide ground stop, the FAA funding request could grow to $50 billion
stories.summary: The administration asked for $30.1 billion on Nov 12. Speaker Mike Johnson says Congress will consider up to $50 billion. House Democrats say $9 billion already approved is unspent.
stories.happened: On Nov 13 the FAA ordered a nationwide ground stop after what it called “excessive data flooding the systems” at a radar site in Amarillo, Texas, and a radio site in El Dorado, Arkansas. The administration's $30.1 billion request (about $10.1 billion for air traffic control modernization) went to lawmakers Nov 12; Speaker Johnson said Congress would consider up to $50 billion in the lame-duck session.
stories.why: Appropriations ranking members Rosa DeLauro and James Clyburn say $9 billion of the $14.4 billion appropriated for air traffic control upgrades remains unspent, and the extra roughly $20 billion hasn't been explained.
stories.next: A hearing with FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford is planned for early December. The money may ride on year-end legislation.

stories.title: Ten-man England beat Spain 3-2 in Madrid
stories.titleSafe: Spain v England in Madrid: the Nations League decider
stories.summary: Kane, Konsa and White scored for England. Oyarzabal's penalty came after Elliot Anderson's foul on Lamine Yamal, which left England with ten men.
stories.happened: Harry Kane scored a first-half penalty, then Ezri Konsa and Ben White scored within five second-half minutes. Spain pulled one back through Mikel Oyarzabal's penalty after Anderson fouled Yamal, and England finished with ten. James Trafford made late saves.
stories.why: France, Belgium, England, Germany, the Netherlands, Portugal and Norway are named as quarter-finalists in UEFA's matchday report. Greece went out despite 11 points on head-to-head.
stories.next: UEFA's report doesn't name the eighth quarter-finalist.
